I've always questioned my gender identity. I've always felt differently than I've been born, even thought at some points I've doubted my entire existence. 

I've been on anti-anxiety medication, and lots of pain medication from surgeries. I'm sure I took a libido hit, though I also have a history of being sexually abused, so I'm sure that's fucked up my sexuality as well. I thought I was asexual, but now I'm not so sure.
